title: The Gone Gloves
scene: At 11:20 AM, the ski resort spare gloves vanished. High wind stopped the chairlift from 11:00 to 11:40.

suspects.name: Rolf Pike
suspects.testimony: I was teaching on the bunny slope at 11:20.
suspects.alibiProof: The slope camera shows Rolf with a class at 11:19.

suspects.name: Sofia Reed
suspects.testimony: I was at the lift station at 11:20.
suspects.alibiProof: The station log shows Sofia's badge at 11:18 and 11:26.

suspects.name: Lars Vale
suspects.testimony: I was riding the chairlift at 11:20, enjoying the view.
suspects.contradiction: The lift stopped at 11:00, and glove wool was caught in Lars's zipper.

suspects.name: Anika Cole
suspects.testimony: I was in the rental shop at 11:20.
suspects.alibiProof: The rental log shows Anika's scan at 11:21.
